findings: The host patch sets the SDRB frontend swap: logical channel 1 names physical RX1 and TX1A_Direct1; channel 0 names RX2 and TX2A_Direct1.
NativeRadioSession.tune_rx selects state 3 for frequencies below 1.2 GHz, including the 435.1 MHz uplink; the policy agrees with sdrb_defaults.hpp.
The historical exported RF control audit maps state 11/J3 to the RX1 RLP-470+ path and corresponding RX2 path. This is a documented route, not a measured passband.
NativeRadioSession.tune_tx keeps the shared TX route off because the direct TX A connector bypasses it.
No documented channel or receive-route mismatch was found that justifies changing route policy for this test.
limits: Read-only source review; no GPIO, PA, FPGA, boot or RF control changes performed.
The historical RF control audit is an exported schematic/netlist review, not evidence of present switch voltage, population or physical path loss.
The deployed Python module hash was not confirmed by the short console import attempt; retained hashes identify reviewed checkout files only.
Source mapping does not establish actual LibreSDR output power, antenna efficiency, receiver sensitivity or duplex isolation.
next_step: Measure actual LibreSDR TXA output at 435.1 MHz with an available RF analyzer before choosing another bounded RF change.
